summary: Linear address search over an array of fixed-size records. Reads the array start pointer from this+0x0C and the element count from this+0x10, then walks records forward by stride 208 (0xD0) until the record address equals a2 or the count is exhausted. Returns the zero-based record index when found, -1 when not found or when the count is not positive.

operations.description: Read element count v2 from this+0x10.
Initialize result to -1 (not-found sentinel) and index counter v4 to 0.
Guard on element count v2 > 0; when the count is not positive, skip the search and return the -1 sentinel.
Read search pointer i from this+0x0C (start of the record array).
Iterate while the record pointer i does not equal the target a2, advancing i by stride 208 (0xD0) each step.
Increment counter v4; if it reaches the element count before a match, return the -1 sentinel.
Return the record index v4 when the pointer i matches the target a2.

unresolved: Record element layout and stride 0xD0 semantics depend on the caller (0x0040BCD0).
Whether a2 is a record pointer or a field address embedded in records is unresolved; only the address equality test is known.
